summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes due 20__, with interest payable annually and a change-of-control repurchase at 101% of principal. The filing is a routine debt shelf takedown; pricing terms, coupon, maturity, and size are left blank in the preliminary document. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, Citigroup, HSBC, Morgan Stanley, and RBC Capital Markets, with listing expected on the NYSE. No special-situations event is present; the item to watch is final pricing and use of proceeds.
